lines.en: At night I fly close to the leaves.
Wings quick, sound tiny.
I do not take the open; I thread leaf gaps.
The jungle's damp holds me up.

lines.zh: 我绕着一盏灯飞了三圈。
lines.en: I circle a lamp three times.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是灰褐的，不显眼。
lines.en: My wings are grey-brown, unremarkable.
I drift toward the light.
I fly a stretch, then perch.

lines.zh: 叶背面的纹路我都认得。
lines.en: I know every vein on the leaf's back.
I avoid where the webs are.
I fly up along the trunk.
The jungle at night is louder than by day.

lines.zh: 我扇了扇翅膀，落在叶尖。
lines.en: I fan my wings and land on a leaf tip.
I fly straight, rarely turning.

lines.zh: 我不高飞，风会把我吹走。
lines.en: I do not fly high; the wind would take me.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在叶上，很小。
lines.en: My shadow on the leaf is tiny.

lines.zh: 我停在叶脉上，收着翅膀。
lines.en: I rest on a vein with wings folded.
I groom my antennae stroke by stroke.

lines.zh: 我闻到了另一片叶子的味道。
lines.en: I smell another leaf.
At night I am at my best.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀铺平，吸一点凉气。
lines.en: I spread my wings and take the cool air.
I live long, longer than butterflies.

lines.zh: 我的鳞粉在月光下发白。
lines.en: My scales look pale in moonlight.

lines.zh: 我停着，像叶上一块旧斑。
lines.en: I rest like an old stain on the leaf.

lines.zh: 树上有很多像我这样的。
lines.en: There are many like me on this tree.

lines.zh: 我在等夜里最静的时候。
lines.en: I wait for the stillest part of the night.
There is a tear in one wing.
I fold my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 这片叶是我昨晚停过的。
lines.en: This is the leaf I rested on last night.

lines.zh: 我听见林子里有东西在爬。
lines.en: I hear something crawling in the trees.
I have seen that mesh once before.
I shift a little behind the leaf.
Are you going to bottle me?
I am quicker than your hand.

lines.zh: 你的灯笼很亮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your lantern is bright. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我停在你的袖子上，就一下。
lines.en: I will rest on your sleeve. Just once.
My scales fall at a touch.
Approach, and I go still.
When you move, my wings quiver.
The night is long. You will not catch me.
A lot of my scales came off.
I fly crooked, unable to hold my line.
Another tear in my wing.
I drop to the dirt with a wing bent under me.
The pain makes my wings tremble.
I hide in the shadow of the stalk.
One of my antennae is bent.
That left my flight unsteady.
I can still fly, only slowly.
Do not touch my wings again.
I will not touch what is in your palm.
I only take a little nectar.
That thing has no petals.

lines.zh: 你把灯举远了，我再过去。
lines.en: Move the lamp away and I will come.

lines.zh: 我试探着靠近那点甜味。
lines.en: I test my way toward that sweetness.
Something else is mixed into that sweetness.
I only want to perch on it.
Your hand is too warm.
Two more wingbeats and I land.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就落下去。
lines.en: If you keep still, I will land.
You knocked me off course.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀蹭到你的手指。
lines.en: My wing brushed your fingers.
A little dust of scales fell.

lines.zh: 我落到地上，赶紧爬起来。
lines.en: I drop to the ground and scramble up.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，往叶子那边飞。
lines.en: I go around you toward the leaves.
One bump and I change course.
You nearly pinched me.

lines.zh: 我贴在你肩上停了一下。
lines.en: I rest on your shoulder a moment.

lines.zh: 我们别在同一个灯下挤。
lines.en: Let us not crowd the same lamp.
Again, and I fly higher.
I wait on the leaf, finding by scent.
There will be an answer in the night.
My wings will make a sound.
There are many of my kind in this jungle.
First I find a good leaf.
This takes time. No rushing.
I fly a little above it.
We circle a lamp together.
My life is long enough. No hurry.
It must be done before dawn.
I land on a flower and sip.
I taste a drop of dew.
This is too heavy.
I cannot carry it, only nudge it.
A petal — I rest on it.
These scales are not mine.
I nudge it into a leaf gap.
It is sweet, but wrong.
I circle it, afraid to land.
I touch it once and rebound.
Something moves under the lamp.
I see it and go around.
That is not a flower. It is alive.
I hang under the leaf.

lines.zh: 翅膀合起来，我就不显眼。
lines.en: Wings folded, I am hard to see.
My antennae test the air.
I have fixed on that shadow.
It is much bigger than me.
I fly deeper into the leaves.
This night is not calm.
I keep circling it.
It cannot match my turns.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶子飞，它就看不见。
lines.en: Among the leaves, it loses me.
I settle behind it.
My flight makes no sound.
Its hands are swinging.
If it will not stop, I keep circling.
I know this canopy well.
I slip through a gap in the leaves.
When it turns, I move.
I butt into it. Very light.
I have no teeth, only a body.

lines.zh: 我撞在它脸上，然后飞开。
lines.en: I hit its face and fly off.
That would not break skin.
I beat my wings at it.
It swipes; I am already gone.
I fear being pinched, so I only bump.
Do not take this force seriously.

lines.zh: 撞完我立刻躲进叶影里。
lines.en: I strike, then slip into the leaf shadow.

lines.zh: 我只想把你赶出这片叶。
lines.en: I just want you off this leaf.

lines.zh: 我从茧里钻出来，翅膀是湿的。
lines.en: I come out of the cocoon, wings wet.
I shake a long time before they spread.
My first flight, at night, is weightless.
Leaves and damp everywhere.
My scales dry slowly.
I recognize the smell of the jungle.
I circle the trunk halfway.
My life is longer than I expected.

lines.zh: 湿翅膀贴住了第一片叶。
lines.en: My wet wings cling to the first leaf.
I look up and see the moon.
One lick of flame and my wing edges scorch.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，撞在叶子上。
lines.en: I drop from above and hit a leaf.
Dew wraps me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得翻了几个身。
lines.en: The blast throws me tumbling.

lines.zh: 一根细刺扎穿了我的翅。
lines.en: A thin point punched through my wing.
The pattern on my wings scrambles.
No nectar, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光过后，我的翅还在抖。
lines.en: After the flash my wings still tremble.
No leaves below, only dark.
